title: Godot XR tools XRcontroller3D issue
body:
### Tested versions
4.7.1.stable

### XR Tools version
4.5.1-stable

### System information
Meta Quest 3 (Standalone VR Editor application, no Link/PC connection)

### Issue description
A severe tracking failure occurs when using the native Godot VR Editor app standalone on the headset. After a few hours of overall device/editor use, controller tracking permanently dies across all projects. 

While the headset tracking and display video continue to function normally, both controller hands become permanently locked at the origin coordinate `(0, 0, 0)`. The player cannot move or turn via the controllers. Reopening the projects or restarting the editor does not resolve the issue. 

This behavior appears to be triggered by focus changes or the device entering sleep mode, causing the OpenXR session handles to drop entirely and fail to re-initialize. This issue began occurring suddenly three days ago, potentially coinciding with a recent headset firmware update.

### System information
quest 3

### Steps to reproduce
1. Launch the Godot 4.7.1 VR Editor natively on a Quest 3 headset.
2. Open or create an XR project utilizing Godot XR Tools v4.5.1.
3. Allow the headset to enter sleep mode, or change application focus away from the editor during a development session.
4. Wake the headset/return focus to the editor. 
5. Observe that the controller hands are now permanently locked at `(0,0,0)` and fail to resume tracking.
